snippet.title: Kimi No Hitomi Ni Hit Me! - Trailer
snippet.description: Entergram & Giga presents to you game geeks the upcoming visual novel this February 22, 2018. Kimi no Hitomi ni Hit Me is was first launched in PC last January. Now, this game has transitioned to the PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita in Japan.the game is a novel type game.
